faqs.question: What does a web development company do?
faqs.answer: A web development company designs, builds, and maintains websites and web applications, covering frontend interfaces, backend logic, database integration, and performance optimization. Fajraan Tech handles the full process from planning to launch and ongoing support.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a custom website?
faqs.answer: Most custom websites take between 3 and 8 weeks depending on complexity, number of pages, and required integrations. Simple landing pages can launch in under 2 weeks, while custom web applications or e-commerce stores may take longer.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a website and a web application?
faqs.answer: A website mainly presents information to visitors, while a web application allows users to interact with data, log in, and perform actions like placing orders or managing accounts. Fajraan Tech builds both, depending on what a business needs.

faqs.question: Does Fajraan Tech build WordPress and Shopify websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fajraan Tech develops WordPress websites for content-driven businesses and Shopify or custom e-commerce stores for businesses that sell products online, including secure payment gateway setup.

faqs.question: What technologies does Fajraan Tech use for web development?
faqs.answer: Fajraan Tech builds frontends with React.js, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, and backends with Node.js and Express.js, along with modern API integrations for scalable, secure web solutions.

faqs.question: What is the difference between native and cross-platform apps?
faqs.answer: Native apps are built separately for iOS and Android using platform-specific code, offering the best performance, while cross-platform apps share one codebase across both platforms, reducing cost and development time. Fajraan Tech builds both depending on the project's goals.

faqs.question: Should I build my app with Flutter or React Native?
faqs.answer: Flutter and React Native both allow a single codebase to run on iOS and Android. Flutter tends to offer more consistent UI across platforms, while React Native integrates well with existing JavaScript teams. Fajraan Tech recommends the right framework based on your app's requirements and team skillset.

faqs.question: Can Fajraan Tech build desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fajraan Tech develops custom desktop applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux using modern frameworks, with a focus on performance, security, and integration with enterprise systems.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
faqs.answer: A typical mobile app takes 6 to 12 weeks to build, depending on features, platforms, and backend complexity. Simpler apps can launch faster, while apps with custom backends and integrations take longer.

faqs.question: Does Fajraan Tech provide app maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fajraan Tech provides ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, and updates after launch to keep mobile and desktop applications running smoothly across operating system versions.

faqs.question: What is AI automation for business?
faqs.answer: AI automation uses artificial intelligence and workflow tools to handle repetitive business tasks, such as data entry, ticket routing, and follow-ups, automatically and without constant human input. Fajraan Tech builds custom automation that connects directly with your existing apps and systems.

faqs.question: How does an AI chatbot help with customer support?
faqs.answer: An AI chatbot answers common customer questions instantly, qualifies leads, and handles support around the clock, only escalating complex issues to a human agent. This reduces response times and frees up your support team for higher-value work.

faqs.question: Can an AI chatbot be trained on my company's own data?

faqs.question: What business tasks can be automated with AI?
faqs.answer: Common tasks that can be automated include customer support replies, lead qualification, data entry between systems, ticket triage, appointment scheduling, and syncing information across CRMs and internal tools.

faqs.question: Is AI automation affordable for small businesses?
faqs.answer: AI automation can be scoped to fit different budgets, from a single chatbot handling FAQs to full workflow automation across multiple tools. Fajraan Tech designs solutions based on which tasks offer the most time savings first, so small businesses can start small and scale up.
